notes: All five pinned v2 networks and the four legacy v1 checkpoints are included and verified locally (about 1.4 GB).
No network connection or populated cache is required.
v2 (default) runs network 1; use --folds 0,1,2,3,4 for the evaluated 5-network ensemble and --mirror for test-time mirroring.
Use --model v1 with --ensemble 1 through 4, or --models 42,123,456,789, for the legacy U-Net consensus.
Use --top-n and --threshold to match the browser automation settings.
DICOM input and manual mask editing use the web app.
Software parity uses a synthetic fixture; a representative clinical reference is pending.
